changes.evidence: Black Panther: N'Jobu is undercover in Oakland in 1992, and Zuri tells T'Challa on screen, 'Your uncle took a War Dog assignment in America. Your father placed me there to observe.' He served the War Dogs (the dataset's name is 'The War Dogs') until he betrayed Wakanda. The record leaves that group out. Keep the 'left' title: he turns on Wakanda.

Luke Cage S2 episode 1 ('Soul Brother 1'): Bobby Fish names the Rivals on screen as 'Shades, Comanche, and Romeo's old crew', and Shades and Comanche trade the Rivals greeting ('Rivals?' / 'We ain't got none'). It is a gang he belonged to before his first title (the S1 episode 4 Seagate flashback), so it is a past group that the record leaves out. The Stokes stage stays as it is: he serves as an informant until Shades kills him, and he never leaves.
